question: Ken: Where’s my pen? Leo: It’s in the _____ .
explanation: 解析：你有看到我的筆嗎？它在「抽屜」裡。

question: Kevin wants to take a three-day trip to Tainan, and he has to take his pet cat with him. Now, he is looking for a place for his pet and him. What may he type（輸入）on the computer?
explanation: 解析：文中提到　Kevin　計畫一趟三天的臺南之旅，而他必須帶著他的寵物貓一起過夜，因此他必須尋找歡迎寵物的旅館，故選(Ａ)。(Ｂ)寵物書籍(Ｃ)寵物食品(Ｄ)寵物衣服。

question: Don’t put too many things on the _____ . They are for people to climb up or go down.
explanation: 解析：不要在「樓梯」上面放置太多的東西。它們是供人們上下樓的。

question: John, please _____ to mop the stairs and do the dishes before half past twelve.
explanation: 解析：John，請「記得」在十二點半前拖樓梯跟洗碗。

question: What a _____ summer night! I killed（殺）almost thirty mosquitos（蚊子）and did homework for three hours.
explanation: 解析：多麼「糟糕的」夏夜！我殺了將近三十隻蚊子並且寫了三個小時的作業。

question: Jamie broke her mom’s favorite cup while sleepwalking last night. She wants to know why people sleepwalk and the ways to stop it. What may she type（輸入）on the computer?

options.A: The ways to break a cup
options.B: The ways to clean a kitchen

explanation: 解析：Jamie　是在夢遊時打破了杯子，因此她想了解「夢遊」的原因以及可能的解決方法，搜尋關鍵字應與　sleepwalking　有關，選項(Ｄ)「Sleepwalking problems and tips」最符合。其他選項與主題無關或太狹隘：(Ａ)是在教如何打破杯子；(Ｂ)是清潔廚房的資訊；(Ｃ)是找杯子的店。

question: Snow always _____ her pets, Snowball and Snowman, before she has dinner.
explanation: 解析：Snow 總是會在吃晚餐前「餵」她的寵物，Snowball 和 Snowman。

question: _____ I can’t understand（理解）anything you’re saying.
explanation: 解析：「冷靜」！我無法理解你正在說的任何事。

question: Shane: Is it 4:15 now? Jane: Yes, it’s a quarter _____ four now. The garbage truck（垃圾車）is coming. I need to go out and take out the trash.
explanation: 解析：Shane：現在是　4　點　15　分嗎？Jane：是的，現在是　15　分「經過」了　4　個小時。垃圾車快來了，我必須要外出倒垃圾了。

question: There are a lot of activities in the _____ , but I don’t like the busy life there.
explanation: 解析：「都市」有許多活動，但我不喜歡那裡忙碌的生活。

question: It’s 11:45 now, it means a _____ to 12:00. Cinderella should go home before 12:00, so she ran out of the party quickly（很快地）.
explanation: 解析：現在是　11　點　45　分，表示「一刻鐘」後是　12　點。Cinderella 必須要在　12　點前回家，所以她很快地跑出派對。

question: The teacher said, “You can take a ten-minute _____ .　Get some water and come back at 10:30.”
explanation: 解析：根據句意「休息十分鐘、去喝水再回來」，語意為「休息」，(Ａ)　break　正確。

question: Be careful! Don’t fall into the _____ ! It’s very deep（深的）.
explanation: 解析：小心！不要掉進「洞」裡！那裡很深。

question: The cat went _____ the hole and ran away（逃走）.
explanation: 解析：那隻貓「穿過」那個洞跑走了。

question: I made a lot of breakfast and ate all of them this morning. _____ , I feel hungry now. What’s wrong with me?
explanation: 解析：我早上做了很多早餐並且全部吃光了。「然而」，我現在覺得很餓。我怎麼了？

question: Do you remember the CD I was looking for for months? I _____ found（找到） it in a small shop. Look, here it is!〔112.會考〕
explanation: 解析：句中提到花了數個月找某張　CD，「終於」在小店中找到，故答案選(Ｃ)。(Ａ)幾乎(Ｂ)甚至(Ｃ)終於(Ｄ)仍然。

question: When I was taking a shower, my sister was climbing a tree in the garden（花園）, then she fell down and _____ her leg.
explanation: 解析：當我正在淋浴時，我妹妹在花園裡爬樹，接著她就從樹上跌下來並且「摔斷」腿。

question: My parents worked at the desk from 7:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. They _____ finished their work.
explanation: 解析：我的雙親從早上七點到晚上七點在桌前工作。他們「終於」完成工作了。

question: This dreamcatcher can _____ you from bad dreams.
explanation: 解析：這個捕夢網可以「保護」你不做惡夢。

question: When I was playing video games in my bedroom, I heard _____ was climbing up the stairs.
explanation: 解析：當我正在我的房間打電動時，我聽到「某人」正在爬樓梯的聲音。

question: Mr. Smith _____ the office at five o’clock, and then he made dinner for her daughter.
explanation: 解析：Mr. Smith 五點「離開」辦公室，然後為女兒做晚餐。

question: It took Rudy and Julia some time to get their couch（長沙發） _____ the door of their new apartment（公寓）.〔111.會考補考〕
explanation: 解析：Rudy　和　Julia　花了一些時間才讓長沙發「穿過」公寓的門。(Ａ)橫過(Ｂ)藉由(Ｃ)在…裡面。

question: I’m _____ done with my homework. Just give me five more（更多）minutes.
explanation: 解析：我「快要」寫完作業了，再給我五分鐘。

question: Jim always forgets（忘記）my birthday. He has asked（已問過）me many times and still can’t _____ it.〔106.會考〕
explanation: 解析：Jim　總是忘記我的生日。他已經問過我許多次且仍然無法「記得」它。(Ａ)回答(Ｂ)慶祝(Ｄ)了解。

question: Yesterday evening at 11:30, Mrs. Huang was feeding her baby girl, and her husband was _____ for the first time. He made Mrs. Huang worried（擔心的） about his health.
explanation: 解析：昨天晚上　11　點半，Mrs. Huang 正在餵她的小女孩，然後她的丈夫正在第一次的「夢遊」。他讓 Mrs. Huang 擔心他的健康。

question: Mr. Baker worked at the desk all day. It’s nice for him to drink a cup of tea and _____ after a hard day’s work.
explanation: 解析：Mr. Baker 在書桌前工作整天。在一天的辛勤工作後，喝杯茶並且放輕鬆對 Mr. Baker 而言是很不錯的。

question: About _____ of the classmates are from the USA, and the others are from the UK.
explanation: 解析：可以填 half 或 a quarter，但要注意：half 當量詞時不需要加 a，而 quarter 前面則必須加 a，所以正確用法是 about half of the classmates 或 about a quarter of the classmates。班上大約「一半」的同學是來自美國，其餘的是來自英國。

question: Idyia was playing video games in her bedroom when her lovely _____ friend called her.
explanation: 解析：當　Idyia　正在房間打電動時，她可愛的「密」友打給她。(Ａ)糟糕的(Ｂ)害怕的(Ｃ)死亡的。

question: My grandpa has heart attack（心臟病）for a long time. Doctors are watching his heartbeat（心跳）on a _____ now.
explanation: 解析：我的爺爺長久以來都有心臟病。醫生們正在透過「監視畫面」檢視他的心跳。

question: Paul: I can’t see the video clearly. Can I get _____ to watch it? Police: You bet.
explanation: 解析：我看不清楚影片畫面。我可以「靠近」一點觀賞嗎？

question: Lily studied hard for the test and did well. She could _____ enjoy her weekend.
explanation: 解析：Lily　為了考試努力讀書且做得很好。她「終於」可以享受週末了。

question: Dad: What’s that on the _____ ? Ben: It’s my camera.
explanation: 解析：那是什麼在「地板」上？是我的相機。(Ａ)衣服；(Ｃ)窗戶；(Ｄ)抽屜。

question: The wind was strong this morning. It _____ the window of our house.
Oh no! There is a big mouse over there. I am so _____ !
Read the guide（說明書）first, and then you can _____ the telephone.
explanation: 解析：先閱讀說明書，然後你就能「修理」電話。(Ａ)擦拭(Ｃ)拖地(Ｄ)懸掛。

question: I have some _____ with my phone, but I can’t fix it.
It’s almost time for the magic show. Let’s _____ now.
The trip was _____ . The weather was bad, and the people there were not nice at all.
Mom was making some _____ food in the kitchen at half past twelve.
explanation: 解析：媽媽十二點半時正在廚房煮「寵物」餐。(Ｂ)地板(Ｃ)抽屜(Ｄ)窗戶。

question: Godwin gave Glory a beautiful dreamcatcher. It only took（花費）him a _____ of an hour to buy it.
explanation: 解析：Godwin　給了　Glory　一個美麗的捕夢網。他只花了「十五分鐘」去買它。(Ａ)樓梯(Ｂ)訣竅(Ｃ)一半（複數）。

question: Lisa ate _____ for lunch because she wasn’t hungry.
Going to work has become（已經成為）a _____ experience for me since（自從）the metro line near my house closed. It now takes me over two hours to get to the office.〔111.會考補考〕
explanation: 解析：住家附近的捷運線關閉而必須花費兩個多小時才能到達辦公室，可知上班變成「可怕的」經驗，故選(Ｃ)。(Ａ)過去的(Ｂ)成功的(Ｄ)有用的。

question: The box is too heavy. Let’s _____ it together.
When mom and dad walked into the garden, my sister and I _____ with our pet, Snow.
explanation: 解析：從屬連接詞 When（當…）接的是瞬間動作，用「過去簡單式」，主要句子則用「過去進行式」表達持續進行的動作。

question: When it _____ to rain, we _____ the clothes in the balcony（陽臺）.
explanation: 解析：當雨「開始」下的時候我們「正在」陽臺「晒」衣服。說明過去某個時間正在進行的動作，持續的動作。was / were　再加上動詞加 ing。S＋was / were＋V-ing。

question: When the teacher walked into the classroom, the students _____ to each other.
explanation: 解析：當老師走進教室，學生都正在跟彼此說話。用「過去進行式」。

question: When Kim broke her favorite cup, she _____ and _____ even remember it. The next day, she felt sad and cleaned the dishes all morning.
explanation: 解析：根據前一句　“Kim broke her favorite cup”，動作發生在過去，因此空格應搭配過去進行式　was sleepwalking（她當時正在夢遊），以及過去簡單式　didn’t even remember（她當時甚至不記得），符合句中描述的時間順序與語意。選項(Ｂ)的時態最正確。

question: What _____ you doing at ten last night?
explanation: 解析：主詞為　you，詢問當時正在做的事（明確的過去時間點），應用過去進行式　were＋V-ing。

question: Joe: Oh my... How did you hurt your back? Lee: I _____ when I _____ a heavy dining table.
explanation: 解析：當我「正在搬」很重的餐桌時，我「跌倒」了。

question: Tina: What _____ you doing when the earthquake（地震）started? Tom: I was _____ in the bathroom when the earthquake started.
explanation: 解析：地震發生時，你正在做什麼呢？過去進行式　was / were＋V-ing。

question: What a terrible day! When we _____ the picnic at noon, it started to rain.
explanation: 解析：at noon 正中午要用過去進行式。

question: Roy: Did you go to the music club at nine forty-five? Lisa: You bet! I went to the music club at _____ .
explanation: 解析：九點四十五分，即「差一刻鐘到十點」。

question: A: Why didn’t you say goodbye to Ethan when you left? B: He _____ , so I didn’t want to wake him up.
explanation:
解析：B　已經離開了，所以他離開的時候的時態是簡單過去式。而當他離開時伊森正在睡覺，所以空格處需使用過去進行式　“was / were＋V-ing”。選(Ｃ)。
語譯：A：你為什麼離開的時候沒有跟伊森說再見？　B：他那時候正在睡覺，所以我不想叫醒他。

question: At this time yesterday, Mr. Rokk _____ the bathroom when the terrible earthquake（地震） _____ .
explanation: 解析：昨天的這個時候，這場可怕的地震發生時洛克先生正在上廁所。「上／使用廁所」是可持續的動作，用「過去進行式」，地震「發生」時，是瞬間動作，用「過去簡單式」。

question: I’ll _____ the city library at half past ten. I have a big test tomorrow.
explanation: 解析：我在十點半會「前往」城市圖書館。

question: Judy: What time is it? Is it 4:45 now?　 Leo: Yeah. It’s a quarter _____ five.
explanation: 解析：a quarter to five　表示再　15　分鐘就　5　點，同　4:45。

question: When I woke up at midnight（半夜）, it _____ cats and dogs
explanation: 解析：當我半夜醒來時，「正在下」傾盆大雨。當一過去動作發生時，另一動作當時正在進行中，用「過去進行式」作答。

question: Dad: When is the TV show? Mom: It starts at ten thirty. Dad: Oh, it’s at _____ .
explanation: 解析：1～30　分鐘，用「數字（分）＋after / past＋數字（點）」，但若用 half，則通常用 past＋數字（點）。

question: When Dad left for his office this morning, Mom _____ the dishes.
explanation: 解析：今天早上當爸爸動身前往辦公室時，媽媽「正在洗碗盤」，用「過去進行式」作答。

question: When I _____ home, my only daughter was playing online games with her classmates. Didn’t she need to do her homework?
explanation: 解析：got home（到家）是瞬間動作，不可用進行式，所以用「過去簡單式」。

question: Mom: Why you smiled（微笑）happily in the morning? Daughter: I _____ a wonderful（美好的） dream last night. I _____ in a park, the sun was shining（照耀）, and the birds were singing. It was very peaceful（和平地）. I didn’t want to wake up.
explanation: 解析：說明過去某個時間正在進行的動作，持續的動作。was / were 再加上動詞加 ing。S＋was / were＋V-ing。

question: Iris: I get up at _____ in the morning. Mia: Why do you get up so early? What for? Iris: To exercise with my friends in the park.
explanation: 解析：Iris 起得很早，要跟朋友去公園運動，「五點二十分」較符合。

question: Rita: Isn’t the movie at a quarter to seven? Lily: That’s right. It’s at _____ . Let’s hurry up, or（否則）we’ll（將）be late for the movie.
explanation: 解析：電影在「差一刻鐘到七點」，即「六點四十五分」。

question: When I checked the clock, it was _____ . I needed to leave soon because school started at six thirty.
explanation: 解析：a quarter after six　表示　6:15，距離學校六點半上課的時間很接近，所以必須快點離開。

question: When I got to the park at 4:15, some kids _____ around and _____ with a ball.
explanation: 解析：描述抵達當下看到的情況，兩個動作同時進行，使用過去進行式　were running　和　playing。

question: A: Hurry! The baseball game is on TV at nine. We are late for the game. B: No, we aren’t. It’s five _____ nine now. Take it easy.
explanation:
解析：(Ａ) “five to nine” 表示五分鐘後九點（8:55）(Ｂ) “five past nine” 表示九點過後五分鐘（9:05）(Ｃ)無此用法，字面的意義表示「現在是九點過後的五點」(Ｄ)無此用法，字面的意義表示「現在是九點前的五點」。因為棒球賽還沒開始，所以推斷現在還沒九點，選(Ａ)。
語譯：A：快點！電視上的棒球賽九點就開始了，我們要遲到了。B：不，我們沒有。現在是八點五十五分。

question: When I _____ to the flower shop, Scott _____ a walk with his dog in the street yesterday.
explanation: 解析：時態是「昨天」，第一空格　get　是瞬間動作沒有進行式，第二空格正在遛狗，要用「過去進行式」。

question: My father likes to watch the movies. When I came home at 7:00 last night, he _____ on the sofa and _____ the movies at that time.
explanation: 解析：and 是對等連接詞，所以前後動詞的時式要一致。

question: Daddy: What was Mommy doing when you _____ from school? Lisa: She _____ in the kitchen.
explanation: 解析：come 是瞬間動作，只能用過去式。當妳從學校回到家時媽媽正在做什麼（was＋V-ing　過去進行式），媽媽正在廚房煮飯（was＋V-ing　過去進行式）。

question: Jill: I usually get up at eight fifteen from Monday to Friday. Lynn: Do you get up at _____ eight on weekends, too? Jill: No, I usually get up at _____ on weekends.

options.B: a quarter to; a quarter to nine
options.C: a quarter after; eight and a quarter

explanation: 解析：a quarter past eight 就是八點十五分。

question: Our dog got lost（失蹤）in the park today. We couldn’t find（找到）it all day. How can I _____ ?
explanation: 解析：我們家的狗走失了，整天都無法找到它。我怎能「放輕鬆」呢？

question: I was brushing my teeth when the phone _____ .
explanation: 解析：主句為過去進行式，when　引導的子句電話響為瞬間動作用過去簡單式。正確為　rang。

question: Mark: Mom, _____ you and aunt May _____ brunch（早午餐）at 10:00 this morning? Mom: Yes, we had a good time at that time.
explanation: 解析：have「吃」，可以用進行式；今天早上十點，所以用「過去進行式」，即 was / were＋V-ing。

question: Brian: _____ you hear the ghost（鬼）story of the school last night? Zoe: No! Don’t tell me about it.
explanation: 解析：時間是　last night，所以時態用「過去式」。

question: Someone broke the artworks（藝術品）in the middle（在…中間）of the night in the museum. The policemen were _____ the bad guys at the time.
explanation: 解析：某人半夜破壞了博物館的藝術品。警察們當時正在「尋找」壞人。選項(Ａ)(Ｂ)(Ｃ)是「可拆雙字片語動詞」，受詞是代名詞時，須放在片語動詞的中間，即　clean it up / take it out。(Ｃ)語意不合。

question: When I _____ into the room, they were watching a video.
explanation: 解析：走進房間為瞬間動作用過去簡單式，主句是過去進行式。正確為　walked。

question: Josh: Why did you go to bed at fifteen to two a.m. this morning? Lisa: I couldn’t help it. I had too much homework to do and sat up until（直到） _____ . Josh: Poor Lisa.
explanation: 解析：Lisa　在凌晨「差　15　分到　2　點」才上床睡覺，即她一直熬夜到　1：45。

question: Miss Wu: _____ David doing his homework when I _____ the classroom? Class leader（班長）: Yes, he was.
explanation: 解析：走進教室的那一刻 enter 的動作就算完成，因此用過去簡單式，而 do his homework 是持續的動作，所以用過去進行式。

question: My sisters and I did housework together at 7 p.m. last night. When I _____ the car, my sisters _____ the puppies（小狗）.
explanation: 解析：「我和姊妹們昨晚七點一起做家事。當我正在洗車的時候，姊妹們正在餵小狗。」題幹中的時間線索「at 7 p.m. last night（昨晚七點）」表示過去某一特定時間點正在發生的動作，因此應使用過去進行式（was/were + V-ing）。

question: The students of 701 _____ in the library, and the students of 703 _____ badminton（羽毛球）in the playground.
explanation: 解析：「701班的學生正在圖書館裡閱讀，而703班的學生正在操場上打羽毛球。」and 是對等連接詞，所以前後動詞的時式要一致，且句子描述的是兩個班級在同一過去時間點正在進行的活動，因此需要用過去進行式。

question: Mr. Wang wasn’t playing board games at 15:30 yesterday afternoon, but his children _____ .
explanation: 解析：but 用於前後文意相反，第一句有否定 be 動詞過去式，因此第二句簡述句用肯定 be 動詞過去式即可。

question: I woke up at in the middle（中間）of the night today and _____ back to sleep at all.
explanation: 解析：at all 之前須出現否定句型並用過去式作答。

question: What _____ at half past nine last night when your mom _____ the dishes?
explanation: 解析：前後時態一致，時間發生在昨晚，使用過去進行式「were doing / was washing」。

question: Ruby works in the restaurant. When the guests left, she _____ the floor right away（立刻）.
explanation: 解析：Ruby 在餐廳工作。當客人離開時，她立刻「清掃」地板。前後兩件事皆須使用過去式。

question: I _____ the floor when my mom called me last night.
The concert started at half _____ seven last night.
The kids are hungry because it’s half _____ six. It’s time for dinner.
A: Were George and Harper _____ on the phone then?　B: Yes, they were.
A: What _____ you doing at eight?　B: I was taking a shower, and James was sleeping.
Johnny _____ the computer when his sister walked in the room.
A: Is it ten _____ seven now?　B: Yes. It is six fifty.
Alex: When _____ Doris _____ Japan? Mark: At about 10 o’clock in the morning.
explanation: 解析：「離開」是瞬間動作，不可用進行式，而句尾時間是「早上」，所以用「過去簡單式」。

question: Jacky: What time is it? Is twenty after seven now? Ann: Yes, _____ .
explanation: 解析：twenty after seven　意為「七點二十分」，與(Ｄ)完全對應。

question: Jason: You looked tired and late for work today. Jimmy: I had a terrible night last night. I went to bed at half past three, and I couldn’t fall asleep. options.A: you can watch some ghost movies
options.B: you can drink a cup of hot coffee next time
options.C: you can go to work next time
options.D: you can drink a cup of warm milk next time

explanation: 解析：Jimmy 今天早上看起來很累並且工作遲到了。Jason 建議他下次可以喝些溫牛奶，可以比較放鬆且很快睡著。

options.D: I was drinking some warm milk.

question: A black shape（形狀）was standing next to my bed when I opened my eyes at 3:10 a.m. He wanted to do something bad to me, but luckily, my dad came into my room in time（及時）. _____

options.C: I could not fall asleep in the dark.
options.D: However, I could not have a good night’s sleep.

question: _____ in the daytime（白天）is not good for you. You may not sleep well（好）at night and feel（感到）tired the next day.〔101.基測〕
explanation: 解析：用「動名詞…」（V-ing...）當主詞，指「在白天睡覺」，視為單數，故接單數動詞。

question: They are talking about _____ a concert.
explanation: 解析：about　為介系詞，後接動名詞　V-ing。正確答案為　giving。

question: _____ delicious food is easy for Mr. Wilson.
explanation: 解析：動作當主詞通常要用「動名詞…」（V-ing...），但也可用「不定詞…」（To V...）的形式。

question: She loves _____ , so she wants _____ a singer.
explanation: 解析：love(s)之後可接　to V　或　V-ing，而　want(s)之後須接　to V...，而「當」歌手，動詞用　be。

question: Brian _____ playing tennis（網球）with his classmates after school.
explanation: 解析：enjoy　後面接動名詞…（V-ing...），其他(Ａ)(Ｂ)(Ｃ)之後皆接不定詞…（to V...）。

question: It was important for Kevin _____ his homework quickly（快速地）because he had to（必須）help his parents sell fruit in the night market（市場）.〔96.基測Ⅱ〕
explanation: 解析：此句型中　It　是虛主詞，真主詞是後面的「不定詞…」（to V...）。

question: To learn English, Joe decided _____ the English club.
explanation: 解析：decide　後面接「不定詞…」（to V...）。

question: They finished _____ dinner and went for a walk.
explanation: 解析：finish　後接　V-ing。表示「吃完晚餐」後接著散步。

question: Playing sports at least（至少）three times a week _____ good for your health.〔105.會考〕
explanation: 解析：題目中的關鍵字為　Playing sports，為單一動作，而　good　為形容詞，故選單數　be　動詞（is）。

question: My brother loves _____ his homework and _____ to music in his bedroom.
explanation: 解析：我哥哥喜歡在房間做功課和聽音樂。love(s)後面可接　and　連接的兩個「動名詞…」（V1-ing... and V2-ing...）或兩個「不定詞…」（to V1... and V2...），第二個不定詞的　to　要予以省略。

question: Yuna needs _____ a video before 3 p.m.
explanation: 解析：need　後面接　to V。表示「需要做影片」的動作。

question: I practice _____ English with the CD every day.
explanation: 解析：practice　後面要接「動名詞…」（V-ing...）。

question: My mother is good at _____ . She makes dinner for us every day.
explanation: 解析：at　是介系詞，其後的動作要用動名詞（V-ing）。

question: Liam: What do you want _____ when you grow up? Nina: I plan _____ a singer like IU.
explanation: 解析：Liam　問　Nina「長大後想做什麼？」Nina　回答「我計畫成為像　IU　一樣的歌手」。want　與　plan　之後都接　to V。

question: My mom is good at _____ fried（油炸的）fish. We can’t wait _____ it every time she makes the dish.
explanation: 解析：good at＋V-ing...，因為介系詞之後的動作要用　V-ing...；can’t wait＋to V...：迫不及待要做　V...　的動作。

question: It is important for us _____ enough sleep every day.
explanation: 解析：此句型中　It　是虛主詞，真主詞是後面的「不定詞…」（to V...）。

question: It’s not easy _____ when you get butterflies in your stomach.

options.A: to sing in front of people
options.C: to singing in front of people

explanation: 解析：當你緊張時，要「在大家面前唱歌」並不容易。It’s not easy　為虛主詞句型，後面須接　to V。

question: Playing in the water _____ lots of fun on a hot summer day.〔98.基測Ⅰ〕
explanation: 解析：「動名詞…」（V-ing...）當主詞視為單數，所以用單數形式的動詞，且「做某事很有趣／好玩」用　... be a lot of / lots of fun。

question: Playing games on the cellphone（手機） _____ popular with high school students.〔108.會考〕
explanation: 解析：以一「動名詞…」當主詞，視為單數，形容詞　popular　之前須加進單數　be　動詞（is）。

question: Why is there so much trash _____ the classroom floor?
explanation: 解析：all over：遍及，即「教室地板上為何到處有這麼多垃圾？」。選項(Ａ)須把　in　改成　on。

question: My family are talking about _____ a picnic on the Moon Festival.
explanation: 解析：about　是介系詞，其後的動作要用「動名詞…」（V-ing...）。

question: _____ a second language（語言）is important for your future.
explanation: 解析：本句主詞為動名詞　V-ing「學習」，表達行為本身。

question: To become a great singer, Yuki keeps _____ every morning.

options.C: practicing to sing with her teacher

explanation: 解析：為了成為一位好歌手，Yuki　每天早上「持續和她老師練習唱歌」。keep　後要接動名詞（V-ing），而　singing　是　practice　的受詞。

question: I’m sorry for _____ your book.
explanation: 解析：for　為介系詞，後接　V-ing　表示原因。正確答案為　losing。

question: _____ to music makes me happy.
explanation: 解析：V-ing　作主詞，表示聽音樂這件事。正確答案為　Listening。

question: Mom planned _____ us out for dinner, so she didn’t need _____ dinner.
explanation: 解析：plan(ned)＋to V...；人＋need＋to V...。

question: _____ a new restaurant near our place. Isn’t _____ a good idea to give it a try tonight?
explanation: 解析：我們家附近「有」家新餐廳用　There’s...；「今晚去試吃一餐」不是個好主意嗎？用虛主詞　it　代替真主詞　to give it a try tonight。

question: Hebe: What do you want _____ ? Ella: A teacher. I plan _____ a job at the school near my house.
explanation: 解析：Hebe　問　Ella「想要成為什麼？」，Ella　回答「老師」，因此第一格應使用　want to be，即　What do you want to be?。若用　What do you want to do?，意思是「你想做什麼？」，不能以 A teacher. 　回答。第二格　plan　後接　to V，表示「計畫做某事」，故　plan to find a job　正確。答案選 (A)。

question: I usually carry（帶）a camera on my trips; taking pictures _____ a good way for me to remember the experience（經驗）.〔100.基測Ⅰ〕
explanation: 解析：「動名詞…」當主詞視為單數，所以用單數形式的動詞。

question: On Emma’s first day at work, she felt（感覺）very nervous. Interviewing famous people was new to her, but she told herself, “ _____ is part of being a reporter.”
explanation: 解析：句中主詞是　Interviewing famous people（動名詞片語），表示一件事，因此後面補述的句子也要用動名詞開頭，保持語法一致，選(Ｂ)。(Ａ)(Ｃ)為動詞原形開頭，不可作主詞補語；(Ｄ)的　to talk them　少了介詞　to / with，語意不完整。

question: To learn English, Lisa keeps _____ English every day.
explanation: 解析：keep　和　practice　後面要接「動名詞…」（V-ing...）。

question: I think _____ is more fun（更好玩）to go to the movies with my friends than（比）with my family.〔100.北北基〕
explanation: 解析：I think　之後可接由連接詞　that　引導一句子（主詞＋動詞＋…）當受詞，此時　that　可予以省略，而用虛主詞　it　代替句尾的「不定詞…」（to V...）。

question: I’m very sorry for _____ you _____ so long.
explanation: 解析：介系詞　for　之後的動作要用「動名詞…」（V-ing...），而　keep　之後的動作須用「動名詞…」（V-ing...）。

question: Our teacher often likes us _____ to bed late because _____ enough sleep is important for junior high school students.
explanation: 解析：我們老師時常希望我們不要太晚就寢，因為取得充足的睡眠對國中學生是很重要的。第一空格是「人1＋like(s)＋人2＋not to V...」，而第二空格則是利用「動名詞…」當主詞。

question: _____ a successful writer like J.K. Rowling is Luke’s dream.
explanation: 解析：Luke 的夢想就是成為像 J.K. Rowling 一樣成功的作家。動作當主詞要用「動名詞…」（V-ing...）或「不定詞…」（To V...）的形式。

question: Melody kept _____ her watch during the party because she wanted _____ home early.
explanation: 解析：Melody 在派對期間不斷看著她的手錶，因為她想要早點回家。kept（持續）＋V-ing...；want(ed)＋to V...。

question: Never stop _____ English. Always keep _____ speaking English every day.
explanation: 解析：不要停止學習英文。請保持每天練習英文。stop＋V-ing...：不做　V...　的動作；keep＋V-ing...：持續做　V...　的動作。

question: My grandpa likes _____ up early and going jogging（慢跑）at the park.
explanation: 解析：like　後面可接「不定詞…」（to V...）或「動名詞…」（V-ing...），但是　and　為對等連接詞，and　後面用「動名詞…」當受詞，所以前面也要用「動名詞…」當受詞。

question: When I was walking with my dog in the Sunny Park, I couldn’t _____ my new cellphone. Everyone helped me to _____ it.
explanation: 解析：當我跟我的狗在晴天公園散步時，我「找」不到我的手機。每個人都在幫我「尋找」手機。(Ｂ)須改成 find; look。

question: Learning foreign（外國的）languages（語言） _____ me to know more（更多）about other countries.〔96.基測Ⅰ〕
explanation: 解析：「動名詞…」（V-ing...）當主詞視為單數，所以用動詞現在式單數形（helps）。

question: Brad: What do you want _____ in the future? Lily: Help poor people all over Taiwan.
explanation: 解析：Brad　問　Lily　未來想「做」什麼？Lily　才會以「幫助臺灣各地貧窮的人。」回應。

question: It _____ hot. Why not go swimming this afternoon?
explanation: 解析：天氣「漸漸變得」熱了，用「現在進行式」。

question: The girl kept _____ after she fell down the stairs.
My parents enjoy _____ a movie on weekends.
Mom started _____ the house after work.
Exercising often _____ very important for children.
It is not easy for Anna _____ dinner for her family.
We are thinking about _____ on a trip to the USA next month.
Dad always tells me not _____ only for tests（考試）. If（如果）that’s all I’m doing, he says, I will（將）soon lose interest（興趣）in learning.〔98.基測Ⅰ〕
explanation: 解析：tell＋人＋not to V...：告訴某人不要…。

question: _____ there early, he got up at 6 a.m. today.
explanation: 解析：「不定詞…」（To V...）可表「目的」，意思是「為了…」。

question: Liz: _____ spelling（拼字）long words（字）easy for you? Max: No. I always have trouble _____ long words.
explanation: 解析：Liz：拼長字對你而言簡單嗎？ Max：不。拼長字對我而言總是有困難。問句主詞是「拼長字」這一個動作視為單數主詞，句尾　easy　是形容詞，故選單數　Be　動詞；而　have trouble（很難…）之後的動作用動名詞　V-ing...　的形式。

question: _____ early and exercising _____ good for our health.
explanation: 解析：句首配合後方　exercising　用　V-ing；早起（Getting up early）與運動（exercising）是由　and　連接的兩個獨立動作，be　動詞用　are。

question: Jill: Does Dad need _____ his car? Liz: Sure he does. His car needs _____ .
explanation: 解析：人＋need(s)＋to V...；物＋need(s)＋V-ing...。

question: Reading comic books or playing computer games _____ lots of fun.
explanation: 解析：某動作「好玩」用　be fun，而　or　連接兩主詞時，須由靠近動詞的主詞決定動詞，故用單數動詞。

question: My mom likes _____ the house clean, so she doesn’t like us _____ anything in our bedrooms.
explanation: 解析：第一空格「人＋like(s)＋to V... / V-ing...」；第二空格「人1＋like(s)＋人2＋to V...」。

question: Emi: _____ spelling（拼字）lessons difficult? Roy: Yes. There’s always a lot to learn about them.
explanation: 解析：問句主詞是「拼字課程」，是複數形式，句尾　difficult　是形容詞，故選複數　Be　動詞。

question: After many years of hard work, _____ .

options.B: he did not like his future job
options.C: he loved keeping his house clean
options.D: he could keep working for 365 days at a time

explanation: 解析：在很多年的努力工作之後，「他成為一個有名氣的歌手」。

question: The famous lawyer _____ . Do you need him for your case（案例）?

options.B: seldom helps poor people in need
options.C: loves making videos for his YouTube channel
options.D: is good at fighting for people’s rights

explanation: 解析：那個名律師「很會為人們的權利而戰」。你需要他來處理你的案例嗎？

question: My mom is a busy factory worker, but she _____ .

options.B: tries to make new and yummy food for my family
options.C: hates to make her new dishes with others
options.D: seldom thinks about making new dishes in the kitchen

explanation: 解析：我媽媽是個忙碌的工廠作業員，但是她「設法為我的家人做出新的美味食物」。

question: Greg: What do you want to be in the future? Grace: _____

options.A: You can also be a great farmer.
options.B: I plan to interview the popular writer later.
options.C: A good doctor like my father.
options.D: What about you?  Do you want to be a basketball player?

explanation: 解析：Greg　詢問　Grace「未來想當什麼？」，Grace　以「（想當個）像我爸爸一樣的好醫生。」回應。

question: Tina: Do you want to go to Ximending with us this afternoon? Mary: _____

options.A: Sure.  Let’s meet in front of our school at 2:00 p.m.
options.B: Yes, we had a lot of time.
options.D: I love to go shopping.  How about you?

explanation: 解析：Tina　約　Mary　今天下午去西門町，所以推測　Mary　和　Tina　約地點碰面。

question: Ella: Murphy owns a company now. _____ Gary: Same here. He was just a worker not long ago.

options.B: That is not a good idea.
options.C: Please don’t make fun of him.
options.D: The road to success is not easy.

explanation: 解析：Same here. 在此用來表示同意，指「我有同感」。

question: Jeff likes toys（玩具）. He plans _____ .

options.B: send different toys to kids all over the world
options.C: made lots of toys for poor kids
options.D: to work in a toy factory and make toys

explanation: 解析：plan(s)＋to V...，即「Jeff　喜歡玩具。他計畫在一玩具工廠工作並製作玩具」。

question: One of the girl’s teeth hurts a lot, but _____ .

options.A: she plans to see the dentist later
options.C: she never brushes them before going to bed
options.D: she needs to brush them twice a day

explanation: 解析：女孩一顆牙齒痛得很厲害，但是「她討厭看牙醫」。

question: Jane: Your brother plays baseball well（好）. Is he on the school team? Rick: _____

options.A: No, he doesn’t practice playing it.
options.B: Yes, he likes to play basketball.
options.C: Yes, he is poor at playing baseball.
options.D: No, but he enjoys playing it very much.

explanation: 解析：回答　Yes，表示參加校隊；回答　No，表示沒有。

question: A famous YouTuber like Cai Aga _____ .

options.A: likes to fighting for people’s rights
options.B: enjoys to plan a day for his YouTube channel
options.C: needs to make videos for his YouTube channel
options.D: hates to have a dream of his own

explanation: 解析：像蔡阿嘎有名氣的影片創作者「必須為他的　YouTube　頻道製作影片」。

question: The baby likes listening to music. When the music is playing, _____ .

options.D: he tries to turn it off

explanation: 解析：那嬰兒喜歡聽音樂。當音樂在播放時，「他不哭了」。(Ｂ)停下來開始哭(Ｄ)嬰兒不會嘗試關掉音樂。

question: Emi: _____ Leo: I practice it every day.

options.A: What do you plan to do this evening?
options.B: Do you want to be a writer?
options.C: Why are you good at playing the guitar?
options.D: How many hours do you practice playing the guitar a day?

explanation: 解析：Leo　回答每天都會練習，所以推測　Emi　問「你為何很會彈吉他呢？」。

question: It’s special for me _____ . Everyone was singing and dancing in their room that night.

options.B: to have a music party on YouTube
options.C: to go home on rainy days
options.D: to go to a family doctor

explanation: 解析：「在　YouTube　開一個音樂派對」對我而言很特別。大家在他們的房間唱歌跳舞一整夜。

question: Liz: What do you want to be in the future? Ken: _____

options.A: I don’t plan to be a police officer.
options.B: I want to be a writer.
options.C: I hate to cook, but I enjoy eating yummy food.
options.D: I love singing.  How about you?

explanation: 解析：Liz　詢問　Ken　將來想當什麼，Ken　回答一項職業名稱。

question: Jill: What do you want to do when you grow up? Alex: _____

options.A: I want to catch a ball.
options.B: My dream is to grow healthy fruit on a farm.
options.C: When I grow up, I want to have a dream.
options.D: I want to do it again in the future.

explanation: 解析：Alex　以「夢想是在農園種有益健康的水果。」回答出　Jill　所問的「長大時，想做什麼？」。

question: Yesterday afternoon, I looked here and there in my bedroom for my watch, _____ .

options.A: and I found them under the bed
options.B: but I just couldn’t find it
options.D: but it was on the bed

explanation: 解析：在臥室到處尋找手錶，「但是就是無法找得到」。選項(Ａ)　them　須改成　it。

question: Ann’s friends kept calling her, so _____ .

options.A: it was fun for her to interview them
options.B: she did not finish reading the book
options.C: she was sorry for talking about them
options.D: she thanked them for getting some exercise

explanation: 解析：Ann　的朋友一直打電話給她，所以「她沒看完那本書」。

question: Mom: Emi, it’s 11:40 p.m. Why do you keep sitting at the desk? _____ Emi: I want to go to bed early, but I need to study for many tests（考試）at school tomorrow（明天）. Mom: My poor girl. Don’t worry about the tests. Just go to bed now.

options.A: It’s not bad to study so late.
options.B: Are you playing with something special?
options.C: Isn’t it bad for your health to go to bed so late?
options.D: Getting up early is important for students.

explanation: 解析：媽媽認為「太晚就寢不是對健康不好嗎？」，她要　Emi　不要擔心明天的考試，就去睡覺了吧。

question: This is my first time to sing in front of so many people. _____

options.A: May I give it a try?
options.B: How come I keep getting butterflies in my stomach?
options.C: It’s my last time to give it up.
options.D: Was I doing a good job when I was singing on stage?

explanation: 解析：這是我第一次在這麼多人面前唱歌。「我怎麼一直感到緊張呢？」。

question: Zoey: Don’t you remember _____ ? When do you plan to give it back to me? Pete: What?! You lent so much money to me? How could it be?

options.D: lending so much money to me

explanation: 解析：remember＋V-ing...：記得做過　V...　的動作（做過了）；remember＋to V...：記得要去做　V...　的動作（還沒做）。由語意是「Pete　向　Zoey　借過錢」，故選(Ｃ)。

passage:
（Ryan’s classmates are thanking him.）
Marco: Why are your classmates so happy?
Ryan: Today is my birthday.  I made a cake for everyone in my class.
Marco: Made a cake?  Could you?
Ryan: Yes, I planned  ___(1)___  a cake for my classmates, and my dad gave me a hand.  He is a good cook in my family, and he loves cooking very much.
Marco: How about you?  Do you love cooking, too?
Ryan: Yes, I started  ___(2)___  a cake last year.  At first, I only made terrible cakes.  Dad told me, “Just keep  ___(3)___  on it.  You can make a yummy cake one day.”  So I often practice it.
Marco: Do you want to be a good cook like your dad?
Ryan: Of course, but I’m not good enough.  I still need  ___(4)___ .
Marco: You work very hard.  I’m sure you can be good at cooking in the future.
Ryan: Thanks, Marco.

explanation: 解析：(1) planned　之後的動作，須接「不定詞…」（to V...）。

explanation: 解析：(2) start　後面可接「不定詞…」（to V...）或「動名詞…」（V-ing...）。
